structured_output.what_is_happening: BEEPLE is a pump.fun token that migrated to PumpSwap about 14 minutes ago. Its description is 'Fees to @beeple via UsePaid': a fee-routing token that sends creator fees to the X account of the artist Beeple. It has gone about 5x from launch, has about 2,000 unique buyers, and leads a crowd of same-name clones. By detection it had already pulled back about 41% from its ATH.

narrative.description: A UsePaid 'fees to a celebrity X account' coin for Beeple, the famous NFT artist. UsePaid is an active Solana meta: the PAID token is around $21M and has been covered by KuCoin news.
narrative.why_spreading: A famous crypto-native name plus the UsePaid fee-sharing meta. The upside is that Beeple might notice, claim the fees, or tweet about it. I found no confirmation that he has.

token_connection.why_this_token: It is the earliest and largest BEEPLE UsePaid token, at about $240k versus under $80k for every clone. It links to a Beeple status and to the UsePaid page.
token_connection.competing_tokens: About 10 same-name clones launched in the last 15 minutes, all under $80k, with two showing $135k-$167k hourly volume at about $17k market cap.

authenticity.evidence: About 2,024 unique buyers in about 14 minutes and $710k volume against a ~$240k market cap. GMGN tags 494 bundler wallets and 596 fresh wallets, bot/degen rate is 65%, and top bundler traders hold 30.7%. No paid boosts. I found no acknowledgement from Beeple; the linked X status returned HTTP 402 and I could not read it.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not see X discussion, or whether Beeple engaged with the coin.

structural_risks: 494 bundler wallets; top bundler traders hold 30.7%
About 41% below ATH, so a 2x from entry needs a new ATH
The creator address has launched 166k tokens (probably the launchpad deployer), so no dev accountability

structured_output.counterargument: Beeple is famous, has tweeted about memecoins before, and UsePaid pays the named account. If he claims the fees or quote-tweets the coin, this canonical token could run 3-5x. Against that: it already dumped 41% from ATH, bundler share is heavy, and most celebrity fee-tokens fade once the first wave takes profits.
unknowns: Whether Beeple has seen, claimed, or tweeted about the coin
What the linked Beeple status says

source_coverage.notes: The X status returned 402 and usepaid.app gave an SSL error. News searches found background on UsePaid (KuCoin) but nothing specific to this coin. There was not enough time for Reddit, Telegram or Discord.

structured_output.thesis: This is the canonical token for a celebrity fee-routing coin in a hot meta, with real breadth: about 2,000 unique buyers. But it has already dumped from its ATH, it is bundler-heavy, and nothing confirms Beeple is engaged. Its odds of doubling are somewhat above the pool average because of the famous name and its canonical status, but not high.
